name: xantar
description: Juego Phaser en TypeScript con Vite
author: Xantar

scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:desktop: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
scripts.build:desktop:dir: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware src vite.config.ts && oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.electron.json electron scripts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --type-aware --fix src vite.config.ts && oxlint --type-aware --fix --tsconfig tsconfig.electron.json electron scripts
